prompt:
Pixel art emblem of the zodiac sign GEMINI: two identical faces in profile, mirror images of each other, joined in one shape like a two-headed figure on a playing card, with one star above each, centred inside a thin-lined regular hexagon frame (all six sides equal) with two mirrored curls of wind behind it.

This is a SYMBOL, not a character: a timeless emblem like a heraldic crest, a carved totem, a stained-glass roundel or a constellation card. Front-facing, perfectly symmetrical, still and dignified. The face is calm and neutral with a steady level gaze, so that anyone born under the sign can see themselves in it. No cartoon expression, no grin, no frown, no eyebrows, no mascot, no cuteness, no story, no pose. Never fierce or scary: no fangs, no snarl. The sign's nature shows only through form: perfect mirror symmetry, light airy curves, two halves of one whole: duality, quickness, conversation.

Style: bold simplified geometric shapes, 16-bit console pixel art, hard square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no dithering. Drawn on a 96 x 96 pixel grid, shown enlarged so each pixel is a clear square. The whole image has a flat solid BLACK background, edge to edge.

Palette: exactly four flat colours plus black: cream, magenta, yellow, sky blue. At most two flat shades of each, nothing else.

Composition: the emblem fills about 65% of the frame. Square image, no text, no letters, no watermark, no signature.
